svg.aria-label: Animated banner: exams with clashes (red lines between exams that share students) move into a calendar of exam sessions; every clash disappears
svg.title: Exam Timetabler

g.text: Builds a university exam timetable where no student has two exams
at once, and spreads each student's exams across the exam period.
clash-free start → simulated annealing with Kempe chains → re-plan with fewest changes
29 pairs of exams share students, so they can never share a session
0 clashes · no student has two exams on the same day
